pretraining: Full-official original RGBNT100 DeMo50 bestE8 plus additional50/new Adam; original identity encoder fixed

anchor.method: AV RGBNT100 changes only Adam weight_decay1e-4->0 for the existing middle/high frequency value-encoder Linear(512,64) WEIGHTS. Low-band value Linear, all biases, LayerNorms, shared M value encoder and remaining optimizer groups retain AS policy. AQ five packed QKV weights already decay0; AS only M projectedQ per-head L2*sqrt8 retained. No new network, parameter, loss, forward, frequency transform, descriptor or inference normalization. AT exact fullQG shows preserved raw/LN band variation but F Linear attenuation; AU sampled four matched training batches finds mid/high selected weight norms .014-.028 and L2 gradients larger than full task in all four batches of both controls. Local observations motivate a test, not decay causality or a guarantee of identity/retrieval gain. Same original teacher42 frozen/fresh expertheads42/newAdam/extra50/hardP8K8/B64/T2/cap.10/mainCE.25/hinge.6/reg.05/MFaux.001 actualunit3584+scored512/BN2/partial0/two backwards/5120. Both ordinary mixed-source and structured controls receive identical optimizer change. Full official8675train/1715Q8575G/50epochs/normalbenchmarkmAP earliesttie/allsixsamebest and8frozenstates. Only2026physicalGPU2/3/max2/onepercard; no201NN/missing49/seeds/T-P.

Gradients remain extremely small; supports precision sensitivity, not a proved individual underflow instruction or retrieval gain. Candidate numerical repair needs fresh matched random/hard native3 pervariant; no gate relaxation.

anchor.routing_change: All existing joint a_S+c_b+psi logits divided by2 before legal-relation masking and softmax. All other routing, conditioning, projections, gates, losses and frozen encoder behavior retain AG.
anchor.attention_decay_limit: Packed QKV includes V. Remaining decay/LR/model/loss and source/band access are unchanged; no QK-exclusive causal claim.
anchor.modality_query_limit: Only M spatial projected Q amplitude removed. K/V/F/crossband unchanged. Not the full QKNorm method or an established identity-relevance mechanism.
anchor.frequency_value_decay_limit: Only two middle/high input Linear weights; low band and every other AS policy retained. Not a new identity mechanism or established cause.
